LOT 111 Shin Oak Drive
Lampasas, TX 76550
$172,800, MLS# 546423

Welcome to Cross Timber Ranch and Lot 111 on Shin Oak Dr.  These 5 acres are nestled back and away from the hustle and bustle of any county road or highway which allows for peaceful outdoor tranquility and for more stars to shine.  This lot sits slightly elevated over its neighbors providing views of rolling hills and land.  Come build your dream home or your escape place with very light building restrictions.  Electricity is available at the street, a well will be needed, and septic is needed too.  Currently, no neighbor has built yet, so you can build your castle and enjoy the tranquility from the lovely quiet views.
